title: L¹ translation estimate for a set with bounded perimeter in a ball
statement: Let n ∈ ℕ, F ⊆ ℝⁿ Borel, R, C ∈ ℝ and w ∈ ℝⁿ, and assume ∫_F div g dL ≤ C for every C¹ vector field g : ℝⁿ → ℝⁿ with compact support, tsupport g ⊆ B_{R+|w|}(0) and |g| ≤ 1 (div g = trace Dg). Then ∫_{B_R(0)} |1_F(z) − 1_F(z − w)| dz ≤ |w|·C.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (F : Set (Euclid n)) (R C : ℝ) (w : Euclid n), MeasurableSet F → (∀ g : Euclid n → Euclid n, ContDiff ℝ 1 g → HasCompactSupport g → tsupport g ⊆ ball (0 : Euclid n) (R + ‖w‖) → (∀ z, ‖g z‖ ≤ 1) → ∫ z in F, LinearMap.trace ℝ (Euclid n) (fderiv ℝ g z : Euclid n →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid n) ≤ C) → ∫ z in ball (0 : Euclid n) R, |F.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) z - F.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) (z - w)| ≤ ‖w‖ * C
